title: NAFEMS LE10, thick plate under pressure
description: Quarter of a thick elliptic plate: inner ellipse (x/2)^2 + (y/1)^2 = 1, outer ellipse (x/3.25)^2 + (y/2.75)^2 = 1 (metres), 0.6 m thick (z from 0 to 0.6), steel (E 210 GPa, nu 0.3), 1 MPa pressure on the top face. Boundary conditions as in TNSB: symmetry on the x and y faces, the outer curved face held in x and y, and the mid-height line EE' on the outer face (z = 0.3) held in z. Target: sigma_yy at D (2, 0, 0.6), on the top surface (NAFEMS, Background to Benchmarks, p. 77).
not_modelled: fea_setup cannot express these supports: fixed_faces hold a face in x, y and z, and sliding_faces take only flat faces facing along an axis. LE10 needs the curved outer face held in x and y only, and the line EE' held in z (the outer face's mid-height line, which exists only if that face is split at z = 0.3).

quantities.label: sigma_yy at D (2, 0, 0.6), top face
quantities.citation: "The Standard NAFEMS Benchmarks", TNSB Rev. 3, NAFEMS, October 1990, Test LE10; D on the top surface: NAFEMS, Background to Benchmarks, p. 77
quantities.tolerance_reason: Not run; set as for the LE1 fine mesh.
